letter.role_title: Working Student (f/m/d) Advanced Analytics and Artificial Intelligence
letter.opening: I am applying for the Working Student position in Advanced Analytics and Artificial Intelligence in Munich. Turning data and AI concepts into solutions that business stakeholders actually use is the combination I have been building towards, from analytics consulting to my Master's in Data Science.
letter.profile_intro: I am an M.Sc. Data Science student at TU Ilmenau with a B.S. in Artificial Intelligence. I worked in SAP data & analytics at TallyMarks Consulting and as a Business Analyst at Tapal Tea, building data pipelines, data models and dashboards for business teams.

achievements.impact: I designed SAP Datasphere data pipelines and used SQL, data validation and reconciliation to keep reporting accurate
I built SAP Analytics Cloud dashboards and translated business requirements into KPI reporting, including a client presentation after which the client purchased SAC
I built a PyTorch retinal OCT classifier with 94.11% accuracy on a 968-image test set and worked on an EfficientNet-B0 and EasyOCR video pipeline for my thesis

letter.problems_section: In your team I would support analytics and AI projects end to end: extracting and validating data, building pipelines, applying machine learning with Python, and turning results into dashboards and clear explanations. I have not yet worked with the cloud data platforms you use, but moving from SAP BW to SAP Datasphere taught me to learn a new data platform quickly.
letter.closing: I am available immediately for 15 to 20 hours per week and am happy to relocate to Munich. I would be glad to discuss how I can contribute.
letter.language_closing: My English is at C1 level (IELTS 8.0), and I am currently learning German (A1).
